#!/usr/bin/env python3
# 7z structure dumper for analyzing output files of the reference binary
import sys, struct, lzma, binascii

data = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
assert data[:6] == b'7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c'
ver_major, ver_minor = data[6], data[7]
start_crc = struct.unpack('<I', data[8:12])[0]
nh_off, nh_size, nh_crc = struct.unpack('<QQI', data[12:32])
print(f"version {ver_major}.{ver_minor} startCRC {start_crc:08x} nhOff {nh_off} nhSize {nh_size} nhCRC {nh_crc:08x}")

def read_uint(b, p):
    f = b[p]
    if f < 0x80: return f, p+1
    mask = 0x80
    val = 0
    n = 0
    for i in range(8):
        if f & (0x80 >> i):
            n += 1
        else:
            break
    val = f & (0xFF >> (n+1))
    for i in range(n):
        val = (val << 8) | b[p+1+i]
    return val, p+1+n

IDS = {0:'End',1:'Header',2:'ArcProp',3:'AddStreams',4:'MainStreams',5:'FilesInfo',6:'PackInfo',7:'UnpackInfo',8:'SubStreams',9:'Size',0xA:'CRC',0xB:'Folder',0xC:'CodersUnpackSize',0xD:'NumUnpackStream',0xE:'EmptyStream',0xF:'EmptyFile',0x10:'Anti',0x11:'Name',0x12:'CTime',0x13:'ATime',0x14:'MTime',0x15:'WinAttrib',0x16:'Comment',0x17:'EncodedHeader',0x18:'StartPos',0x19:'Dummy'}

def parse_streams(b, p, depth=0):
    pre = '  '*depth
    while True:
        i = b[p]; p += 1
        print(f"{pre}StreamsInfo id {IDS.get(i,i):#}")
        if i == 0: return p
        if i == 6:  # PackInfo
            packpos, p = read_uint(b, p)
            nstreams, p = read_uint(b, p)
            print(f"{pre} PackPos={packpos} NumStreams={nstreams}")
            while True:
                i2 = b[p]; p += 1
                if i2 == 0: break
                if i2 == 9:
                    for _ in range(nstreams):
                        v, p = read_uint(b, p); print(f"{pre}  PackSize={v}")
                elif i2 == 0xA:
                    alldef = b[p]; p += 1
                    print(f"{pre}  CRC alldef={alldef}")
                    if not alldef:
                        nb = (nstreams+7)//8; p += nb
                    else:
                        for _ in range(nstreams):
                            crc = struct.unpack('<I', b[p:p+4])[0]; p += 4
                            print(f"{pre}  PackCRC={crc:08x}")
                else:
                    sz, p = read_uint(b, p); p += sz
        elif i == 7:  # UnpackInfo
            assert b[p] == 0xB; p += 1
            nfolders, p = read_uint(b, p)
            ext = b[p]; p += 1
            print(f"{pre} Folders={nfolders} ext={ext}")
            for f in range(nfolders):
                ncoders, p = read_uint(b, p)
                print(f"{pre}  Folder{f} NumCoders={ncoders}")
                total_in = 1; total_out = 1
                for c in range(ncoders):
                    flags = b[p]; p += 1
                    idsz = flags & 0xF
                    cid = b[p:p+idsz]; p += idsz
                    complex_ = flags & 0x10
                    attrs = flags & 0x20
                    print(f"{pre}   Codec {cid.hex()}", end='')
                    if complex_:
                        nin, p = read_uint(b, p); nout, p = read_uint(b, p)
                        total_in = nin; total_out = nout
                        print(f" in={nin} out={nout}", end='')
                    if attrs:
                        psz, p = read_uint(b, p)
                        props = b[p:p+psz]; p += psz
                        print(f" props={props.hex()}", end='')
                    print()
                nb = total_out - 1
                for _ in range(nb):
                    bi, p = read_uint(b, p); bo, p = read_uint(b, p)
                    print(f"{pre}   BindPair in={bi} out={bo}")
                npi = total_in - nb - 1
                if npi == 1:
                    pi, p = read_uint(b, p)
                    print(f"{pre}   PackedStreamIndex={pi}")
                elif npi > 1:
                    for _ in range(npi):
                        pi, p = read_uint(b, p)
            # CodersUnpackSize
            assert b[p] == 0xC; p += 1
            for f in range(nfolders):
                v, p = read_uint(b, p)
                print(f"{pre}  Folder{f} UnpackSize={v}")
            while True:
                i2 = b[p]; p += 1
                if i2 == 0: break
                if i2 == 0xA:
                    alldef = b[p]; p += 1
                    print(f"{pre}  UnpackCRC alldef={alldef}")
                    if alldef:
                        for _ in range(nfolders):
                            crc = struct.unpack('<I', b[p:p+4])[0]; p += 4
                            print(f"{pre}  FolderCRC={crc:08x}")
                    else:
                        nb = (nfolders+7)//8; p += nb
                else:
                    sz, p = read_uint(b, p); p += sz
        elif i == 8:  # SubStreams
            print(f"{pre} SubStreamsInfo (raw, stopping)")
            return p
        else:
            print(f"{pre} unknown streams id {i}")
            return p

def parse_header(b, depth=0):
    pre = '  '*depth
    p = 0
    i = b[p]; p += 1
    print(f"{pre}Header type {IDS.get(i,i)}")
    if i == 0x17:
        p = parse_streams_inner(b, p, depth+1)
        # then decode
        return
    # main header: 4 = MainStreams, 5 = FilesInfo

def parse_streams_inner(b, p, depth):
    return p

hdr = data[32+nh_off:32+nh_off+nh_size]
print("header bytes:", hdr.hex())
# decode generically
p = 0
i = hdr[p]; p += 1
print("first id:", IDS.get(i, i))
if i == 0x17:
    # EncodedHeader: parse PackInfo & UnpackInfo manually

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# LZMA decoder with operation logging - for analyzing encoder decisions
import sys, struct

class RangeDec:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.pos = 0
        self.code = 0
        self.range = 0xFFFFFFFF
        # init: first byte must be 0
        b = data[0]
        self.pos = 1
        for _ in range(4):
            self.code = (self.code << 8) | data[self.pos]; self.pos += 1
    def normalize(self):
        if self.range < (1 << 24):
            self.range <<= 8
            self.code = (self.code << 8) | self.data[self.pos]; self.pos += 1
    def decode_bit(self, probs, idx):
        p = probs[idx]
        bound = (self.range >> 11) * p
        if self.code < bound:
            self.range = bound
            probs[idx] = p + ((2048 - p) >> 5)
            self.normalize()
            return 0
        else:
            self.range -= bound
            self.code -= bound
            probs[idx] = p - (p >> 5)
            self.normalize()
            return 1
    def decode_direct(self, n):
        res = 0
        for _ in range(n):
            self.range >>= 1
            self.code -= self.range
            if self.code < 0:  # python ints; emulate 32-bit
                pass
            self.code &= 0xFFFFFFFF
            t = self.code - self.range
            if self.code < self.range:
                res <<= 1
            else:
                self.code -= self.range  # wait
                res = (res << 1) | 1
            # redo properly below
            self.normalize()
        return res

def decode_direct(rd, n):
    res = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        rd.range >>= 1
        res <<= 1
        if rd.code >= rd.range:
            rd.code -= rd.range
            res |= 1
        rd.normalize()
    return res

def bittree_decode(rd, probs, base, nbits):
    m = 1
    for _ in range(nbits):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Minimal LZMA encoder for a fixed op sequence - debugging tool
import sys

class RangeEnc:
    def __init__(self):
        self.low = 0  # 64-bit
        self.range = 0xFFFFFFFF
        self.cache = 0
        self.cacheSize = 1
        self.out = bytearray()
    def shift_low(self):
        if self.low < 0xFF000000 or self.low > 0xFFFFFFFF:
            temp = self.cache
            while True:
                self.out.append((temp + (1 if self.low > 0xFFFFFFFF else 0)) & 0xFF)
                self.cacheSize -= 1
                if self.cacheSize == 0: break
                temp = 0xFF
            self.cache = (self.low >> 24) & 0xFF
        self.cacheSize += 1
        self.low = (self.low << 8) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    def encode_bit(self, probs, idx, bit):
        p = probs[idx]
        bound = (self.range >> 11) * p
        if bit == 0:
            self.range = bound
            probs[idx] = p + ((2048 - p) >> 5)
        else:
            self.low += bound
            self.range -= bound
            probs[idx] = p - (p >> 5)
        if self.range < (1 << 24):
            self.range <<= 8
            self.shift_low()
    def encode_direct(self, value, n):
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            self.range >>= 1
            if (value >> i) & 1:
                self.low += self.range
            if self.range < (1 << 24):
                self.range <<= 8
                self.shift_low()
    def flush(self):
        for _ in range(5):
            self.shift_low()

def bittree_encode(re, probs, base, nbits, sym):
    m = 1
    for i in range(nbits-1, -1, -1):
        b = (sym >> i) & 1
        re.encode_bit(probs, base + m, b)
        m = (m << 1) | b

def rev_bittree_encode(re, probs, base, nbits, sym):
    m = 1
    for i in range(nbits):
        b = (sym >> i) & 1
        re.encode_bit(probs, base + m, b)
        m = (m << 1) | b

class LenEnc:
    def __init__(self):
        self.choice = [1024, 1024]
        self.low = [[1024]*8 for _ in range(16)]
        self.mid = [[1024]*8 for _ in range(16)]
        self.high = [1024]*256
    def encode(self, re, l, posstate):
        if l < 8:
            re.encode_bit(self.choice, 0, 0)
            bittree_encode(re, self.low[posstate], 0, 3, l)
        elif l < 16:
            re.encode_bit(self.choice, 0, 1)
            re.encode_bit(self.choice, 1, 0)
            bittree_encode(re, self.mid[posstate], 0, 3, l - 8)
        else:
            re.encode_bit(self.choice, 0, 1)
            re.encode_bit(self.choice, 1, 1)
            bittree_encode(re, self.high, 0, 8, l - 16)

def encode_ops(ops, lc, lp, pb):
    re = RangeEnc()
    ismatch = [[1024]*16 for _ in range(12)]
    isrep = [1024]*12
    isrepg0 = [1024]*12
    isrepg1 = [1024]*12
    isrepg2 = [1024]*12
    isrep0long = [[1024]*16 for _ in range(12)]
    posslot = [[1024]*64 for _ in range(4)]
    specpos = [1024]*115
    align = [1024]*16
    lenc = LenEnc()
    replenc = LenEnc()
    litprobs = [[1024]*0x300 for _ in range(1 << (lc+lp))]
    state = 0
    reps = [0,0,0,0]
    pos = 0
    out = bytearray()
    for op in ops:
        posstate = pos & ((1 << pb) - 1)
        if op[0] == 'lit':
            re.encode_bit(ismatch[state], posstate, 0)
            sym = op[1]
            prev = out[-1] if out else 0
            probs = litprobs[((pos & ((1<<lp)-1)) << lc) + (prev >> (8 - lc))]
            ctx = 1

                    # standard: encode bits of sym from MSB

                    sym = (sym << 1) & 0xFF
                    re.encode_bit(probs, ((1 + mbit) << 8) + ctx, bit)
